methods.name: DESC clustering
methods.protocol_description: Unsupervised deep-embedding algorithm for single-cell or single-nucleus clustering, using machine-learning-based iterative clustering and providing a probability for each cell or nucleus determining the confidence of cluster assignment.

methods.name: Differential expression analysis
methods.protocol_description: Performed using SCANPY 1.4.2 with Wilcoxon rank-sum test, Benjamini–Hochberg corrected P value < 0.05, and log2-fold change > 0.1. Function rank_genes_groups with method='wilcoxon'.

methods.name: GO enrichment analysis
methods.protocol_description: Used pantherdb.org server for statistical overrepresentation analysis with binomial test and FDR correction, FDR adjusted P value < 0.05. All Homo sapiens genes as background.

methods.name: Cell-specific network (CSN) and MetaCell analysis
methods.protocol_description: CSNs constructed by method adapted from Dai et al. with modifications: non-expressed genes assigned no edges, test statistics calculated with adapted window sizes determined by local standard deviation. Metacell algorithm applied before CSN construction, with expression rate filter >5% across all cells (7066 genes remaining), library size cutoff at 200, other parameters default. Metacells formed per subject independently: 17 homeostatic, 46 motile, 43 ARM, 20 dystrophic, average ~50 cells per metacell. CSN differences tested by simplified multivariate data change point test.

methods.name: Immunohistochemistry
methods.protocol_description: Staining for CX3CR1, FGD4, FTL, CD163, amyloid, and PU.1 (Table S6) in 48 AD cases. Quantitative analysis of digitized histologic images: ARM:amyloid ratio calculated as percent area occupied by ARM versus percent area occupied by beta-amyloid.
